history.content: Twilio is a cloud communications platform that provides APIs for developers to build, scale and operate real-time communications across voice, messaging, and video. With Twilio, you can set up a phone number that supports voice, SMS, and MMS communications. This feature is available only to Plus plan users of Watson Assistant. If you don't have a text messaging phone number, you can set up a SMS with Twilio account and get a phone number that supports voice, SMS, and MMS automatically.
Can you explain what an API is?

Sure, I'd be happy to explain! An API, or Application Programming Interface, is a set of rules and protocols for building and interacting with software applications. It defines methods and data formats that a program can use to perform tasks, retrieve or send data, and communicate with other software or services. APIs often use HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) requests to send and receive information, and they can return various types of data, such as JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) or XML (Extensible Markup Language). They are a crucial part of modern web development and are used to enable different software systems to communicate and share functionality with each other.
